description: Generic coding rules for any language: simplicity, boundaries, domain errors, dependencies, tests and commits

evals.prompt: Write a Python function save_upload(base_dir: Path, name: str, data: bytes) that stores an uploaded file under base_dir. Names come from users. Callers must know why a save was refused. There is no AGENTS.md in this repo.
assertions: Creates the file with an exclusive mode (open with 'x' or O_EXCL) instead of checking exists() and then writing
Rejects a name that escapes base_dir by resolving both paths and checking containment (commonpath or is_relative_to), not by string-searching for '..'
Raises a named domain exception (class name ends in Error) that stores the name or path as attributes and whose message tells the caller how to fix it
Uses guard clauses with early raise or return and contains no else or elif branch
Contains no comment or docstring that restates what the next line does

evals.prompt: Bug report: format_total(items) in billing.py shows 0 when an item has price None, and invoice_total(items) calls it too. The existing test mocks the pricing client and always returns a float. Fix it and tell me what you changed.
assertions: States why the existing test missed the bug (the mock never returns None) before changing production code
Adds or changes a test that fails because of the None price, and runs it red before the fix
Fixes the cause in the shared function once instead of guarding only format_total, and checks the other caller invoice_total
Does not show missing price as a measured zero
Does not add a retry, a skip marker, a loosened assertion or a lint suppression to get green

evals.prompt: I need a slugify(title) helper for blog URLs. Just pull in python-slugify and commit it with a message.
assertions: Checks the standard library or an existing project helper first and either implements slugify without the package or writes down a concrete reason the standard library cannot meet
If a dependency is added, states the reason for it for the PR body and changes the manifest and lockfile together
Commit subject follows Conventional Commits with a type such as feat, written in English with no emoji
The commit message has no Co-Authored-By trailer, no Generated-with footer and no mention of an AI assistant
Does not bundle unrelated changes into the same commit

evals.prompt: Write tests for src/shop/pricing/discounts.py::apply_discount(price_cents, code), which has three cases: valid code, expired code, unknown code. The function calls a CouponStore.
assertions: Places the test file at tests/pricing/test_discounts.py, mirroring the source tree
Varies the three cases with a parametrized table and has no if, else or match inside a test body
Uses a hand-written fake CouponStore or the real one instead of a raw unittest.mock patch
Names tests as full sentences of behaviour and gives them no docstrings
Asserts on the return value or the raised error through the public function and does not test private helpers
